comment: The statement that consent can be “carried with the data” may be interpreted as embedding a static consent object in every exchanged record. Consent and access policy may change after data creation, requiring current policy evaluation.

anchor.note: p.35 l.Lines 362-365 read as the printed page; section 2.3 agrees

public.text: The statement that consent can be “carried with the data” may be interpreted as embedding a static consent object in every exchanged record. Consent and access policy may change after data creation, requiring current policy evaluation.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that data should carry or reference sufficient policy, purpose, provenance, and consent metadata to permit evaluation against the current authoritative policy or consent record at the point of access.
